applicant_utility.summary: This is an annual, GRE-gated call whose latest published edition (a.a. 2025/26) closed on 30 May 2025, and no a.a. 2026/27 edition had appeared on bandi.unibo.it by 10 October 2026, so plan around a mid-January opening rather than a fixed date. The award pairs a EUR 6,500-per-year study grant for two years with a full exemption from student contributions, leaving only EUR 157.04 in regional tax, stamp duty and insurance to pay. Two gates decide the outcome before merit is ranked: your ISEE must sit between EUR 16,000 and EUR 35,000, and your GRE (taken after 30 May 2020) must reach 290 combined Verbal and Quantitative plus 3.0 in Analytical Writing, with the official report delivered by ETS under recipient code 7850 by the deadline. The money then arrives in six instalments conditioned on credit milestones, so steady progression through the Laurea Magistrale matters as much as the admission itself.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Graduates under 30 with a foreign-awarded bachelor's degree, an existing GRE score and family finances inside the EUR 16,000-35,000 ISEE band who want a fee-waivered Laurea Magistrale in Bologna.
application_readiness_checklist: Book the GRE early enough that the official ETS report (recipient code 7850) reaches Bologna before the deadline; only an unofficial copy can be uploaded with the form.
Obtain an ISEE 2025, or for families with income and assets abroad start the equivalent economic documentation through ER.GO well ahead of the deadline.
Register on Studenti Online in advance and make sure your personal details exactly match your passport, since mismatches break the application.
Watch bandi.unibo.it from mid-January: the window historically opens then and closes at 12:00 CEST at the end of May.
common_rejection_risks: ISEE outside the EUR 16,000-35,000 band excludes you regardless of GRE scores.
The official GRE report arriving after the deadline, even when an unofficial copy was uploaded on time.
A GRE below the section minimums or taken before 30 May 2020.
Turning 30 before the deadline, or any past or present Bologna enrolment, including a career closed after A.Y. 2023-24.
Combining this grant with an incompatible award (other Unibo grants, ER.GO regional scholarships, MAECI, AICS, Erasmus Mundus, Collegio Superiore, CRUI) without exercising the choice rules.
Missing the 10-day unconditional acceptance email to internationaldesk@unibo.it after the award notification.
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The EUR 157.04 regional tax, stamp duty and insurance charge, plus living costs above the EUR 6,500 yearly grant, accommodation in Bologna, travel to Italy, and any instalments delayed or forfeited through missed credit milestones.
document_audit: Only PDF uploads are accepted; passport or identity document scans and the unofficial GRE report must be legible and match your registered identity.
Foreign-income families need the longer ER.GO documentation route rather than a standard ISEE, which takes planning.
In-portal status messages such as 'Domanda inserita' confirm nothing about completeness or eligibility; all checks happen after the deadline.
alerts: The next edition's dates are not published yet and the call is closed at the verification date.
Instalments are conditional: missing a credit milestone delays that instalment and any earlier unpaid ones until the next milestone is met.
Renunciation within the call's cut-off lets the award pass to the next eligible candidate, but withdrawal later means repaying what was received.
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Complete the Studenti Online form inside the window, have ETS transmit the official GRE by the same deadline, file economic documents via ER.GO, then await the post-deadline checks and the ranking published on studenti.unibo.it, with acceptance by email within 10 days of award.

applicant_utility.summary: The A.Y. 2027/28 call is open now, but it is gated by the admission process: you can only submit the scholarship form if you applied for admission and paid the application fee during the Early Bird window of 1 October to 1 December 2026, and the form itself is due by noon Italian time on 15 December 2026. The 64 awards are tiered by campus and programme: Platinum (EUR 10,000) and Gold (EUR 8,000) sit at Milano Leonardo and Bovisa, the Piacenza-specific Gold (EUR 5,000) and Bronze (EUR 2,500) target three named Piacenza programmes, and Silver is a waiver-only award for Cremona, Lecco, Mantova and Piacenza. Even the top tier is paid in two halves, with the second instalment released only after exams are taken in the first semester, and the award collapses if the roughly EUR 190 administrative fee is not paid or enrolment does not happen on time. Renewal for year two is merit-tested at 1000 weighted-grade points for Platinum and 700 for the other tiers by 10 August 2028.
applicant_utility.best_fit: High-GPA applicants to English-taught Master of Science programmes who applied within the Early Bird window and can target Milano Leonardo or Bovisa for the Platinum and Gold tiers, or one of the named Piacenza, Cremona, Lecco or Mantova programmes for the smaller tiers.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm the admission application fee was paid between 1 October and 1 December 2026; without it you cannot enter this call at all.

Submit the scholarship form in Online Services at Benefits and Agreements > Economic benefits > Scholarships for International Master of Science Students a.y. 2027-2028 well before 15 December 2026, 12:00 noon Italian time.
Prepare an Italian or SEPA IBAN in your own name, or a qualifying prepaid card with a limit at least equal to the award, before the outcome email arrives.
Sit an accepted English test early enough for the certificate to be submitted and verified by 4 March 2027.
Keep the mailbox used for the admission application monitored: outcomes arrive by email three to four months after the deadline.
common_rejection_risks: Missing the Early Bird fee window makes you ineligible regardless of grades.
Applying through any channel other than Politecnico di Milano Online Services means automatic disqualification.
Not paying the approximately EUR 190 administrative fee by the deadline in the award email is treated as declining the scholarship.
Failing to enrol in academic year 2027-2028 forfeits the award even after acceptance.
Holding another scholarship from Polimi or any public or private entity without exercising the 10-day right of choice by email suspends all benefits.
Renewal failure: below 700 weighted-grade points (Gold, Bronze, Silver) or 1000 (Platinum) by 10 August 2028 means paying tuition and fees in full for year two.
Withdrawing before the end of the academic year obliges repayment of the amount already received.
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The approximately EUR 190 administrative fee and insurance, Milan-level accommodation and living costs against an allowance that arrives in instalments conditioned on first-semester exams, travel to Italy, and second-year tuition plus fees if the renewal points are missed.
document_audit: The IBAN must be Italian or SEPA-area and held in the student's name, jointly with a family member or another person, or on a prepaid card whose credit limit is at least equal to the scholarship amount.
The English certificate must be verified by the International Students Office; a test booking or self-reported score is not enough.
Acceptance is proven by paying the administrative fee through the Student Affairs instructions, not by replying to the award email.
alerts: The Commission prioritises candidates from countries that have been victims of military aggression or are affected by civil wars, and breaks ties toward younger applicants.
Outcomes can take three to four months after 15 December 2026, yet enrolment and certificate deadlines still run from that point.
Scholarship amounts are treated as income equivalent to employment income; Politecnico covers the IRAP share of taxes.
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Early Bird admission application with fee paid by 1 December 2026, then the scholarship form in Online Services by 15 December 2026 noon, commission ranking, emailed outcome, acceptance via the administrative fee payment and enrolment, with instalments released against first-semester exam credits.
